about: Chord progressions per section from several songs per artist (Hooktheory TheoryTab unless noted), used to build each profile's chord habits (tools/build_style_matrices.py). Numerals are relative to the section's key and mode as the source gives them. Facts about songs (keys, tempos, chord functions), not copies of them. "c": high = Hooktheory section analysis; med = Hooktheory but doubtful; low = a guitar chord site converted to numerals.
